errors.text_span: 图表外侧的横轴范围是 0-40
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate generalization. The image contains two separate charts with two different x-axes. The range 0-40 (in seconds) only applies to the categories of the left chart. The right chart's categories go up to 160 (in characters).

errors.text_span: 音频时长茎叶图和文本长度茎叶图
errors.evidence: The charts are bar charts (柱状图), not stem-and-leaf plots (茎叶图). This is a fundamental misidentification of the chart type, which is repeated throughout the description (e.g., '茎叶柱状图').

errors.text_span: 刻度从 0.5 到 40，间隔为 5 秒
errors.evidence: The x-axis for the audio duration chart is not a continuous scale. It consists of categorical bins representing time ranges (e.g., '0-5', '6-10'). Describing it as a scale from 0.5 with 5-second intervals is incorrect.
The description claims the charts are characterized by a 'best-fit line' (最佳线). There are no such lines present in either chart.

The description lists only 6 of the 8 data points for the text length distribution chart. It omits the second bar for the '21-40' category, which has a value of 29093, and the seventh bar for the '121-140' category, which has a value of 154.
